# scaling Provider

Terraform provider for the Scaling Cloud incident management platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    scaling = {
      source = "scaling-cloud/scaling-cloud"
    }
  }
}

# The API key can also be supplied via the SCALING_CLOUD_API_KEY environment
# variable (recommended), in which case the api_key argument can be omitted.
provider "scaling" {
  api_key = var.scaling_cloud_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for authenticating with the Scaling Cloud API. Can also be set via the SCALING_CLOUD_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Scaling Cloud API. Defaults to https://api.scaling.cloud. Can also be set via the SCALING_CLOUD_BASE_URL environment variable.
